title: ROMEO AND JULIET (The Royal Ballet 2026 – 2027)

title_lang.zh_hk: 羅密歐與茱麗葉 (The Royal Ballet 2026 – 2027)

synopsis: Shakespeare’s timeless tale of star-crossed lovers is transformed in Kenneth MacMillan’s mesmerising ballet. The flourishing of young love is just as present in Romeo and Juliet's meeting on the balcony as in their final moments when they desperately cling to life in the tomb. Prokofiev’s evocative music sets the scene for stolen romantic moments and deadly feuds and sweeps the ballet towards its inevitable and tragic conclusion.

synopsis_lang.en: Shakespeare’s timeless tale of star-crossed lovers is transformed in Kenneth MacMillan’s mesmerising ballet. The flourishing of young love is just as present in Romeo and Juliet's meeting on the balcony as in their final moments when they desperately cling to life in the tomb. Prokofiev’s evocative music sets the scene for stolen romantic moments and deadly feuds and sweeps the ballet towards its inevitable and tragic conclusion.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 莎士比亞筆下那段無奈受命運阻撓的宿命情緣，在麥美倫（Kenneth MacMillan）扣人心弦的芭蕾演譯中綻放全新光芒。無論是羅密歐與茱麗葉在陽台上初相遇時萌芽的熾熱愛意，抑或是在墓穴中拼命抓住最後一絲生命氣息的訣別時刻，這份青春真愛始終同樣動人。浦羅哥菲夫（Prokofiev）極富感染力的音樂，為偷來的浪漫時光與致命的家族恩怨鋪墊起絕佳氛圍，引領整齣舞劇一步步推向那無可避免的悲劇結局。

cast: Fumi Kaneko, Vadim Muntagirov, Francisco Serrano, Ryoichi Hirano, Giacomo Rovero, Lukas B. Brændsrød, Bennet Gartside, Christina Arestis, Harris Bell, Annette Buvoli, Olivia Cowley, Thomas Whitehead, Thomas Whitehead, Lara Turk
